{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Confirm: revenue is a string with commas
print("Revenue data type:", df['revenue'].dtype)
print("First few revenue values:", df['revenue'].head(5).tolist())

# Convert revenue: remove commas and cast to float
df['revenue_float'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Check for sentinel values (QA orders)
sentinel_mask = df['revenue_float'] == 999999.99
print(f"Number of sentinel values (999999.99): {sentinel_mask.sum()}")

# Now filter for LOYAL customers and completed orders
filtered_df = df[(df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & (df['status'] == 'completed')]

# Remove sentinel values from the filtered data
filtered_df_clean = filtered_df[~filtered_df['revenue_float'].isin([999999.99])]

# Check count after cleaning
print(f"Number of completed orders from LOYAL customers (after removing sentinels): {len(filtered_df_clean)}")

# Calculate mean revenue
mean_revenue = filtered_df_clean['revenue_float'].mean()

# Print result
print(f"Mean revenue of completed orders from LOYAL customers (after cleaning): {mean_revenue}")"}
